page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1512.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include any graphics processing units.
This server configuration includes 6442 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, distributed across 16 local SSD devices. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high density of both memory resources and local NVMe storage makes this instance class suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space or high-throughput database operations. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density resource allocation, balancing massive memory capacity with dedicated compute cores and direct-attached storage. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and data processing pipelines.
